title: Gooruf.com
description: In 2016 I created Gooruf.com, a social network for finance. The project was based in Londod and it was aimed to bring together all the players of the world of finance: financial providers, banks, insurances, brokers, final users. It had all the features of a social network, with a custom reputation system that allowed users to be trusted in the community. Unfortunately the project did not make it and it has been abandoned in 2021.

title: Equos.it
description:
In 2022 I created Equos.it WordPress theme, starting from Underscores, and adding Bootstrap.

The website provides horse races stats from a MySQL custom database, using GraphQL. Users management is made with Memberful. Magazine web reader is made with FlippingBook.

title: Mediakey.it
description:
Mediakey is a company specialised in communication, with magazines, digital channels, audio and video production, and events.

This project involved the creation of a custom WordPress theme, an ecommerce in WooCommerce, interfaces with external services like Issuu and CleverReach, and a custom management system to handle their Awards (subscription, voting system, categories, judges, winners, reporting).

title: TRIMaterials.com
description: Custom WordPress theme for TRIMaterials, a company specialised in the production of special materials for buildings. For this project, I developed custom Gutenberg components.

title: NoleggioElettrico.com
description: Custom WordPress theme for NoleggioElettrico, whose business is renting electric cars. For this project, I developed custom Gutenberg components.

title: Movimento Metropolitano
description: Subsidiary of Mercato Metropolitano, Movimento Metropolitano is a no profit organisation dedicated to the promotion of healthy food and a healthy lifestyle. The website is a multilanguage WordPress theme, developed with WPML in English, Italian and Japanese.
